answer: Each agent earns reputation tokens only after a crystal‑locked vesting vault releases them in incremental steps tied to verified task completion. Because the vesting schedule limits reward rate, a sybil farm must front‑pay the full token amount for every fake identity before any payout, making the cost linear in the number of imposters. An attacker therefore faces an upfront expenditure that grows with each new identity, while the genuine agents continue their voyage of gradual earnings without interruption.
